description:
Offline chess: AI, puzzles, opening training and play with friends nearby

Matewave is an offline-first chess app. Play against the AI, solve puzzles, learn openings, or play a friend nearby over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. No accounts, no servers, no ads and no tracking.

Play against the AI

  • Four difficulty levels, from beginner to strong club player.
  • Time controls from bullet 1+0 to classical 30+20, or no time limit.
  • An unfinished game is saved with its whole move list and clock and can be continued later.

Puzzles

  • 1,207 puzzles from the Lichess puzzle database, picked to match your rating.
  • Hints, the solution on request, and progress through multi-move puzzles.

Learn openings with spaced repetition

  • 24 main lines for White and Black.
  • New moves are learned with the piece highlighted; reviews ask only the moves that are due.
  • Earn up to three stars per opening with flawless scheduled reviews.

Play with friends nearby

  • Over Bluetooth LE (no pairing) or the same Wi-Fi network, without internet.
  • Chat with images, draw offers, resignation and rematch.
  • Games are encrypted end to end, and each device has its own key, so a friend cannot be impersonated.

Also

  • The opening name and whether the game is still in theory, shown during games.
  • Rating with a history graph, captured pieces and material balance.
  • Four board color themes.
  • Optional Radio Swiss Jazz background stream (the only feature that uses the internet).
  • Share the app to another phone with a QR code over Wi-Fi.
  • Available in English, Russian, German, Lithuanian, Japanese and Chinese.
